component.name: KaliClean
component.summary: Frosted-glass system hygiene utility for Kali Linux

description.p: KaliClean reclaims memory and disk space with ten carefully scoped cleanup targets, live RAM, swap and disk gauges, and a progress ring with an activity log.
Privileged operations are authenticated in-app with sudo. The password stays in process memory and is never written to disk. No telemetry or network calls are made.
